WITH ckd_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443612,443611)
    UNION SELECT 443612 UNION SELECT 443611
),
event_concepts AS (
    SELECT 'hyperkalemia' AS event_type, descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 434610
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'hyperkalemia', 434610
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'acidosis', descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (435517,4245042)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'acidosis', 435517
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'acidosis', 4245042
),
ckd AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS ckd_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence
    WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ckd_concepts)
    GROUP BY person_id
),
diuretic_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id,
           de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
           CASE
             WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%spironolactone%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%eplerenone%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%amiloride%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%triamterene%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%finerenone%'
             THEN 'Potassium-sparing'
             WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%furosemide%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%torsemide%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%bumetanide%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethacrynic%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chlorothiazide%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chlorthalidone%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%metolazone%'
               OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%indapamide%'
             THEN 'Potassium-wasting'
           END AS exposure_group
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%spironolactone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%eplerenone%' OR
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%amiloride%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%triamterene%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%finerenone%' OR
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%furosemide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%torsemide%' OR
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%bumetanide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethacrynic%' OR
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chlorothiazide%' OR
        LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chlorthalidone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%metolazone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%indapamide%'
      )
),
first_exposure AS (
    SELECT person_id, exposure_group, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
    FROM diuretic_exposures
    WHERE exposure_group IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY person_id, exposure_group
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT fe.person_id, fe.exposure_group, fe.index_date
    FROM first_exposure fe
    JOIN ckd ON ckd.person_id = fe.person_id AND ckd.ckd_date <= fe.index_date
),
flags AS (
    SELECT c.person_id, c.exposure_group, c.index_date,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ec.event_type='hyperkalemia' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hyperkalemia_6mo,
           MAX(CASE WHEN ec.event_type='acidosis' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acidosis_6mo
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = c.person_id
     AND co.condition_start_date > c.index_date
     AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, c.index_date)
    LEFT JOIN event_concepts ec ON ec.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY c.person_id, c.exposure_group, c.index_date
)
SELECT exposure_group,
       COUNT(*) AS patients,
       SUM(hyperkalemia_6mo) AS hyperkalemia_events,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(hyperkalemia_6mo)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS hyperkalemia_rate_pct,
       SUM(acidosis_6mo) AS acidosis_events,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(acidosis_6mo)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS acidosis_rate_pct
FROM flags
GROUP BY exposure_group
ORDER BY exposure_group;

| Exposure group | Patients | Hyperkalemia within 6 mo | Rate | Acidosis within 6 mo | Rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Potassium-sparing | 1,060 | 208 | 19.62% | 219 | 20.66% |
| Potassium-wasting | 8,205 | 1,941 | 23.66% | 1,789 | 21.80% |

Definition used: CKD stage 4–5 diagnosis on/before index diuretic date; events were condition diagnoses occurring >index through 180 days.
